A convention by students, for students

Érudit 5.0 is the biennial mega-event of Allenhouse Public School, Khalasi Lines, Kanpur. Students from leading schools compete, collaborate and learn across academics, technology, leadership and the creative arts.

The student organising team and their mentors have designed every challenge to build critical thinking, teamwork, communication and real-world problem-solving. Past editions ran in 2016, 2018, 2022 and 2024.

3 days28, 29 and 30 November 2026

Guidelines

The essentials. Your Teacher Incharge will receive the full rulebook on confirmation.

Participation and fees
  • Maximum 20 participants per school. Fee is ₹500 per participant.
  • Roboquest carries an additional ₹200 per team, and one robot per school.
  • Individual entries are open for Change the Pinnacle, Jargon, Aignite, Reporters Unplugged and Design X.
  • Only schools taking part in The Character Reboot (E04) are eligible for the overall trophies.
  • Every team needs a Teacher Incharge. A visiting Principal is treated as Guest of Honour.
  • Once registered for an event, a team must take part. Withdrawal leads to disqualification.
On the day
  • Registration confirmation starts at 7:30 am on 28 November 2026.
  • Carry an Aadhar or school ID card signed by the Principal.
  • Bring a school banner (4 ft × 2 ft) or flag (3 ft × 2 ft) for the opening ceremony.
  • Collar and standing mics are provided as requested at registration. A communication centre and first aid are on site.
  • Judges’ decisions are final.
Code of conduct
  • Wear the proper school uniform throughout, and wear your identification code at all times.
  • Maintain discipline and decorum. Do not leave the premises without permission from the host school.
  • Leaving the premises in violation of the code can lead to disqualification of the team.
  • Look after your belongings. Organisers are not responsible for loss or theft.
Travel and stay
  • Outstation schools arrange their own stay. A list of safe, budget-friendly hotels near the venue is shared on confirmation.
  • International schools are hosted by Allenhouse, with accommodation provided.
  • Local transport is provided for outstation and international schools.
Awards
  • Every participant receives a certificate. Positions are mentioned where achieved.
  • Championship and Runners-Up trophies go to the top two schools on points.
